disclaimer: PortDoctor is a static, text-level scanner. Nothing here was compiled or run against a QNX SDP. Rules marked 'guess' are unverified claims about QNX 8.0 and must be checked against the SDP.

findings.title: Links -ldl

context.text: # (For 32-bit, add option "-m32" to MYCFLAGS and MYLDFLAGS.)

findings.message: dlopen/dlsym are believed to be in libc on QNX; a separate libdl may not exist (QNX is believed to ship a stub or none).
findings.remedy: Use ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} in CMake (empty where unneeded), or conditionalise -ldl.
findings.verify: verify against SDP: check for libdl.

findings.title: Compiler hard-coded to gcc/clang instead of qcc
findings.message: QNX software is built with the SDP compiler drivers (qcc for C, q++ for C++), selected with -V<variant>, not the host gcc.
findings.remedy: Do not hard-code the compiler; let the caller set CC/CXX (CC=qcc -Vgcc_ntoaarch64le after sourcing qnxsdp-env.sh) or supply a CMake toolchain file.
